q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
Let me work through this systematically.

## (a) Time left until resolution

Today is 2026-08-16. NVIDIA will host a conference call on August 26, 2026 to discuss Q2 FY2027 financial results. This means the guidance will be released in approximately **10 days**. This is an extremely near-term forecast with minimal uncertainty compared to longer-dated questions.

## (b) Most likely outcome and why

NVIDIA has already provided forward guidance for Q2 FY2027: **$91.0 billion ± 2%**, which translates to a range of **$89.18B to $92.82B** (the midpoint being $91.0B).

Since we are only 10 days away from the actual earnings release, and the company has already formally issued guidance to investors, the question is essentially asking what number NVIDIA will state on August 26, 2026. Companies rarely deviate significantly from pre-announced guidance in the actual earnings call—doing so would damage credibility and trigger regulatory scrutiny.

The most likely outcome is that NVIDIA will reaffirm or make only minor adjustments to its stated guidance of $91.0B ± 2%.

## (c) What would push the value lower?

- A significant deterioration in data center orders between now and August 26
- Unexpected geopolitical developments affecting China export restrictions (the guidance already excludes China revenue, so this is less relevant)
- Major customer cancellations or delays announced publicly
- Broader macro weakness affecting AI capex spending
- Supply chain disruptions
- These scenarios are possible but relatively unlikely given the 10-day window and that guidance was just issued

## (d) What would push the value higher?

- Accelerating demand from existing customers (hyperscalers, cloud providers)
- Additional large customer orders or expansions announced
- Better-than-expected product mix (higher-margin products)
- Upside from verticals not initially modeled
- China revenue materially exceeding expectations despite restrictions
- Again, unlikely to shift materially in a 10-day window after guidance was freshly issued

## (e) Base rate or historical reference values

From the research provided:
- Q1 FY2027 (ended April 26, 2026): $81.6 billion revenue
- Q2 FY2027 guidance: $91.0 billion ± 2%
- This represents approximately 11.5% sequential growth from Q1 to Q2

Historical pattern: NVIDIA has shown strong sequential growth in recent quarters (85% YoY growth in Q1 FY2027). The guidance of $91.0B for Q2 appears consistent with continued AI momentum but at a moderating sequential growth rate.

## Analysis of the range provided (99.5B to 115.5B)

The provided range ($99.5B to $115.5B) is **substantially above** NVIDIA's own stated forward guidance of $91.0B ± 2%. This creates an interesting tension:

1. **Companies almost never miss their own guidance by 8-25 billion dollars** (the delta between $91B and the range floor of $99.5B) in the positive direction just 10 days after issuing guidance.

2. The range suggests either:
   - The forecaster believes NVIDIA will significantly raise guidance between now and August 26 (requires new material information)
   - The range is poorly calibrated relative to actual guidance
   - There's uncertainty about whether the question is asking for actual reported results vs. guidance

3. Given that this is a **guidance question** (not actual results), and the company has already provided guidance of $91.0B ± 2%, the probability mass should be heavily concentrated near $91.0B.

## Probability distribution

- **Around $91.0B (guidance already issued)**: ~85% probability
- **Modestly higher ($92-95B range)**: ~10% probability (upside revisions)
- **Modestly lower ($87-90B range)**: ~4% probability (downside revisions)
- **Significantly above $99.5B**: ~1% probability (would require major surprise announcements)

Given the range provided starts at $99.5B, which is well above stated guidance, the median should reflect the most likely scenario (NVIDIA reaffirms ~$91.0B) but also account for the possibility of upside surprises.

**My estimate:**

The most likely single outcome is $91.0B (the midpoint of stated guidance). However, distributed across the broader range, there is some tail probability of higher guidance. Given the range floor of $99.5B seems arbitrary and the actual guidance is $91.0B ± 2%, I'll estimate:

Low (10th percentile): 89180000000
Median (50th percentile): 91000000000
High (90th percentile): 94500000000
q_45367.research_text:
NVIDIA's forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 revenue, released on May 20, 2026, predicts revenue of \$91.0 billion, plus or minus 2% [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm), [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html). This guidance does not assume any Data Center compute revenue from China [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html).

This forecast is higher than the average quarterly revenue estimate of \$86.84 billion by LSEG [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html). For Q1 FY2027, which ended April 26, 2026, NVIDIA reported record revenue of \$81.6 billion, an 85% increase year-over-year [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm).

NVIDIA will host a conference call on August 26, 2026, to discuss its Q2 FY2027 financial results [nvidianews.nvidia.com](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-sets-conference-call-for-second-quarter-financial-results-6927195).
